13: Black on the OSM back box at line start, 409-414 yds; golfify 390 is short (opengolfapi 418). Tee position is right; the card value is wrong.
14: Golfify Black 230 / Blue 205 have no tee on the ground: the tee was walked 54 yds (Black) and 29 yds (Blue) behind the OSM back box into rough.
16: Black on the OSM back box at line start, 497-500 yds; golfify 480 is short (opengolfapi 521). Tee is right; card value wrong.
18: Black walked back 39 yds behind the OSM line-start box (hole line 527 yds around the dogleg, card 565, opengolfapi 560).
